name: Dragon Disciple
requirements: Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks and the Draconic language
Ability to cast 1st-level arcane spells without preparation
Sorcerers must have the draconic bloodline

features.name: Blood of Dragons
features.summary: Advance draconic bloodline powers with Dragon Disciple levels, or gain them using Dragon Disciple level if you lack Sorcerer levels.

features.name: Natural Armor +1
features.summary: Increase existing natural armor by 1.

features.name: Ability Boost (Strength +2)
features.summary: Permanently increase Strength by 2.

features.name: Bloodline Feat
features.summary: Choose a bonus feat from the draconic bloodline list.

features.name: Dragon Bite
features.summary: Gain the draconic bloodline bite attack, using combined Sorcerer and Dragon Disciple levels for scaling.

features.name: Breath Weapon

features.name: Ability Boost (Strength +2)
